display.purpose: The live status word and the latest thing you said (steps down to 24/19 for long sentences).

title.purpose: Section titles, wordmark, earlier-turn queries, task titles, macro names; 400 for the latest reply and task results.

label.purpose: Times, counts, help, field labels, tags, keycaps, fix hints. Sentence case.

code.purpose: Commands, paths and IDs: the same face at 0.94em in a Rail Water pool. No monospace.

shadows.name: shadow-pool
shadows.purpose: Resting content pools and hovered capsule rows.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: The top capsule and the toast only.

shadows.name: field-well
shadows.purpose: Fields, recorder; hover ring ramp-7, focus ring 2px silt.

shadows.name: ask-well
shadows.purpose: The type-to-Jarvis capsule; focus ring 2px silt.

shadows.name: surface-light
shadows.purpose: Top lip of the top capsule (4% on the delta pool).

shadows.name: channel-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button; the nav indicator uses 0 6px 16px -10px at 60%.

shadows.name: alarm-ring
shadows.purpose: Error banner, failed bubble, error toast (amber-edge #6e5c34 for warn and waiting).

shadows.name: overlay-surface
shadows.purpose: Opaque overlay windows; no cast shadow because the window bounds clip it.

motion.name: ease-flow
motion.purpose: Spring for things that settle: switch knob, toast, nav indicator, icon nudges, row press.

motion.name: t-state
motion.purpose: State changes, droplet colour, row swell.

motion.name: t-arrive
motion.purpose: flowIn arrivals, nav label opening, disclosure pour.

motion.name: button-fill
motion.purpose: Curved liquid surface rising inside a button on hover.

motion.name: nav-flow
motion.value: 560ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), WAAPI stretch across old and new tab at 42%

motion.name: flow-in
motion.value: 460ms ease-out, translateY(10px) scale(0.985) blur(6px) to rest, stagger 40ms capped at 240ms
motion.purpose: Arrivals of page content and the latest exchange.

motion.name: current
motion.purpose: Ambient radial layers under the page; paused when hidden.

motion.name: delta-draw
motion.purpose: Channels draw on render; failed never animates.

motion.name: delta-droplets
motion.purpose: Canvas droplets down each channel; one brighter droplet per new request.

motion.name: voice-droplet
motion.value: waves k=1,2 (mass) and k=3,5,7 (lobes, grow with mic); half-width 92-250px from content, stretch 0.3/frame, settle 0.1/frame; rings 1.6s cubic ease-out, max 6, one per voice onset or every 0.95s while speaking
motion.purpose: Voice pill overlay only; frozen with no rings under reduced motion. Never on interactive dashboard surfaces.

motion.name: droplet-states
motion.value: breathe 4.8s, ripple 1.4s, swirl 1.6s linear, step ripple 1.6s
motion.purpose: State droplet and running task step.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: colour/opacity/shadow fades kept; travel, ambient loops and fills removed; flowIn becomes a 200ms fade

narrative.overview:
The dashboard is a Landsat false-colour delta seen from orbit, and its chrome is water too. Deep slate water is the ground, silt-cyan and sage are the channels and banks that carry meaning, ice-white is the type, and coral is the one warm thing on screen: it appears only where something failed or needs the owner. Your voice is the river; the Overview shows where your words went as a delta of real outcomes, with waves rolling down its channels, not as a grid of metric cards.

Every piece of chrome is a body of water that pools, swells and flows on real events. A floating top capsule replaces the old sidebar; its six destinations sit in one pill whose liquid indicator flows to the chosen tab. Content sits in capsules and pools with large soft radii, lifted off the ground by tone plus a soft shadow cast below. A faint, slow current of lit water drifts under the page. The window is opened, not watched: 920×640 in Qt WebEngine (720×520 minimum), offline, dark only.

One humanist face on a strict five-step ladder carries all hierarchy, code included: there is no monospace. Motion is how water settles: arrivals rise out of a blur, the tab indicator springs, states ripple and breathe; reduced motion keeps every colour and opacity change and removes travel.
keyCharacteristics: One eleven-step cold tonal ramp supplies every neutral: grounds, pools, controls, edges and all three text tiers.
Each outcome owns one colour everywhere it appears: delta channel, droplet, row mark, conversation entry.
Coral means failure or "needs you", and nothing else is warm except the amber caution tier.
Capsules for what you press or type into, pools for what holds content; no hairline dividers.
Depth is tone plus a soft cast shadow below; rings exist only where contrast is owed.
Atkinson Hyperlegible at 13 / 15 / 19 / 24 / 30, weights 400 and 700 only, code in the same face.
Arrivals flow in, the indicator springs, ambient loops pause when hidden; reduced motion keeps colour, drops travel.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every neutral comes from ramp-0..10 or a mix of two ramp steps (pool-water, row-water). The only off-ramp neutral is control-edge, which exists for a contrast floor. Do not introduce greys.

rules.name: The Reserved Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral and its text/ground/edge family appear only for failure or "needs you". A screen where nothing is wrong has no coral on it.

rules.name: The One Outcome, One Colour Rule
rules.body: An outcome's colour is the same in the delta channel, its droplets, the legend mouth, the row mark and the conversation entry. Colour never carries an outcome alone: every mark sits beside its text label.

rules.name: The One Face, One Ladder Rule
rules.body: Only 13 / 15 / 19 / 24 / 30 (ratio about 1.25), only weights 400 and 700, only Atkinson Hyperlegible. Code is the same face in a small pool of deeper water. A new size is a new step that must earn its place.

rules.name: The Numbers Align Rule
rules.body: Counts at delta mouths and task times use tabular numerals; delta counts are right-aligned.

rules.name: The Water On Water Rule
rules.body: Depth is tone plus a soft shadow below. Hover swells a capsule's water (tone and shadow); the capsule stays under the pointer.

rules.name: The Ring Is Owed Rule
rules.body: A 1px ring appears only where contrast is owed or something is wrong: control-edge on fields, the switch and the recorder (WCAG 1.4.11), silt at 2px on focus, coral-edge or amber-edge on error and waiting states. Secondary buttons, pools, rows and tags have no ring.

rules.name: The Capsule Or Pool Rule
rules.body: Controls are capsules, containers are pools at 22px. No square corners and no hairline dividers; space and tone separate things.

rules.name: The Simulation Stays Off The Dashboard Rule
rules.body: The per-frame outline deformation and ripple-ring technique of the voice pill is only for surfaces where performance does not matter, such as the glanceable voice overlay. It must not go on interactive dashboard surfaces: their liquid language comes from CSS shapes, tone, shadows and short transitions.

dos: Do take every neutral from ramp-0..10 (or pool-water / row-water) and use the role it is assigned.
Do give each outcome its one colour in the delta, its droplets, row marks and conversation entries, always beside its text label.
Do keep coral for failure and "needs you", and pair every failure with its fix (a banner action, a fix hint, or a Switch model button).
Do make controls capsules and containers 22px pools, separated by space and tone rather than lines.
Do lift with tone plus the pool or float shadow, and keep the 1px ring for fields, the switch and alarm states.
Do keep type on the 13 / 15 / 19 / 24 / 30 ladder in Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700, code included, with secondary text in ramp-9.
Do show shortcuts as keycaps and destructive actions as quiet buttons that hide immediately and offer Undo.
Do let arrivals flow in on the ease-out curve with capped staggers, pause ambient loops when hidden, and keep colour while removing travel under reduced motion.
Do keep overlay surfaces opaque and on the shared overlay tokens.
Do let the voice droplet follow its content and the microphone, and freeze it still under reduced motion.
donts: Don't build a metric-card telemetry grid; outcomes are shown as the delta and as conversation rows.
Don't bring back a sidebar rail, hairline dividers, nested scroll wells or square corners.
Don't put a ring on secondary buttons, pools, rows or tags.
Don't introduce greys, warm neutrals, or a second warm accent outside coral and amber.
Don't show a state the daemon has not confirmed; prefer an honest unknown.
Don't convey state or outcome by colour alone.
Don't use partial alpha on an overlay surface.
Don't put the voice pill's blob simulation or ripple rings on interactive dashboard surfaces.
